name: wapiti
summary: A vulnerability scanner for web applications.
highlights: -u — The base URL used to define the scan scope (default scope is folder)
--swagger — Swagger file URI (path or URL) to target API endpoints
--list-modules — List Wapiti attack modules and exit
-p — Set the HTTP(S) proxy to use. Supported: http(s) and socks proxies

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --url
flags.description: The base URL used to define the scan scope (default scope is folder)

flags.name: --swagger
flags.description: Swagger file URI (path or URL) to target API endpoints

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: Set scan scope

flags.name: --module
flags.description: List of modules to load

flags.name: --list-modules
flags.description: List Wapiti attack modules and exit

flags.name: --level
flags.description: Set attack level

flags.name: --proxy
flags.description: Set the HTTP(S) proxy to use. Supported: http(s) and socks proxies

flags.name: --tor
flags.description: Use Tor listener (127.0.0.1:9050)

flags.name: --mitm-port
flags.description: Instead of crawling, launch an intercepting proxy on the given port

flags.name: --headless
flags.description: Use a Firefox headless crawler for browsing (slower)

flags.name: --wait
flags.description: Wait the specified amount of seconds before analyzing a webpage (headless mode only)

flags.name: --auth-cred
flags.description: (DEPRECATED) Set HTTP authentication credentials

flags.name: --auth-user
flags.description: Set HTTP authentication username credentials

flags.name: --auth-password
flags.description: Set HTTP authentication password credentials

flags.name: --auth-method
flags.description: Set the HTTP authentication method to use

flags.name: --form-cred
flags.description: (DEPRECATED) Set login form credentials

flags.name: --form-user
flags.description: Set login form credentials

flags.name: --form-password
flags.description: Set password form credentials

flags.name: --form-url
flags.description: Set login form URL

flags.name: --form-data
flags.description: Set login form POST data

flags.name: --form-enctype
flags.description: Set enctype to use to POST form data to form URL

flags.name: --form-script
flags.description: Use a custom Python authentication plugin

flags.name: --cookie
flags.description: Set a JSON cookie file to use. You can also pass 'firefox' or 'chrome' to load cookies from your browser.

flags.name: --side-file
flags.description: Use a .side file generated using Selenium IDE to perform an authenticated scan.

flags.name: --cookie-value
flags.description: Set a cookie to use for every request for authenticated scan. You can put multiple cookies separated by semicolons as a value

flags.name: --drop-set-cookie
flags.description: Ignore Set-Cookie header from HTTP responses

flags.name: --skip-crawl
flags.description: Don't resume the scanning process, attack URLs scanned during a previous session

flags.name: --resume-crawl
flags.description: Resume the scanning process (if stopped) even if some attacks were previously performed

flags.name: --flush-attacks
flags.description: Flush attack history and vulnerabilities for the current session

flags.name: --flush-session
flags.description: Flush everything that was previously found for this target (crawled URLs, vulns, etc)

flags.name: --store-session
flags.description: Directory where to store attack history and session data.

flags.name: --store-config
flags.description: Directory where to store configuration databases.

flags.name: --start
flags.description: Adds a url to start scan with

flags.name: --exclude
flags.description: Adds a url to exclude from the scan

flags.name: --remove
flags.description: Remove this parameter from urls

flags.name: --skip
flags.description: Skip attacking given parameter(s)

flags.name: --depth
flags.description: Set how deep the scanner should explore the website

flags.name: --max-links-per-page
flags.description: Set how many (in-scope) links the scanner should extract for each page

flags.name: --max-files-per-dir
flags.description: Set how many pages the scanner should explore per directory

flags.name: --max-scan-time
flags.description: Set how many seconds you want the scan to last (floats accepted)

flags.name: --max-attack-time
flags.description: Set how many seconds you want each attack module to last (floats accepted)

flags.name: --max-parameters
flags.description: URLs and forms having more than MAX input parameters will be erased before attack.

flags.name: --scan-force
flags.description: Easy way to reduce the number of scanned and attacked URLs. Possible values: paranoid, sneaky, polite, normal, aggressive, insane

flags.name: --external-endpoint
flags.description: Url serving as endpoint for target

flags.name: --internal-endpoint
flags.description: Url serving as endpoint for attacker

flags.name: --endpoint
flags.description: Url serving as endpoint for both attacker and target

flags.name: --dns-endpoint
flags.description: Domain serving as DNS endpoint for Log4Shell attack

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: Set timeout for requests

flags.name: --header
flags.description: Set a custom header to use for every requests

flags.name: --user-agent
flags.description: Set a custom user-agent to use for every requests

flags.name: --verify-ssl
flags.description: Set SSL check (default is no check)

flags.name: --color
flags.description: Colorize output

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Set verbosity level (0: quiet, 1: normal, 2: verbose)

flags.name: --log
flags.description: Output log file

flags.name: --format
flags.description: Set output format. Supported: csv, html, json, md, txt, xml. Default is html.

flags.name: --output
flags.description: Output file or folder

flags.name: --detailed-report
flags.description: level 1 : include only the HTTP requests, level 2 : include HTTP requests and responses

flags.name: --no-bugreport
flags.description: Don't send automatic bug report when an attack module fails

flags.name: --update
flags.description: Update Wapiti attack modules and exit

flags.name: --version
flags.description: Show program's version number and exit

flags.name: --cms
flags.description: Choose the CMS to scan. Possible choices : drupal, joomla, prestashop, spip, wp

flags.name: --wapp-url
flags.description: Provide a custom URL for updating Wappalyzer Database

flags.name: --wapp-dir
flags.description: Provide a custom directory path for updating Wappalyzer Database
